darpan.audit.AuditStatement.statementText: Every invoice and credit memo carries the Shopify order id (the Etail id).
A warranty replacement is paid by that claim's own credit, at the claim's value. The credit and the replacement invoice close each other out.
A return is never treated as replaced by the order it came from.
Every exchange credit belongs to a customer. When the shopper gave none, it belongs to the store's own customer.
A cancelled exchange leaves nothing open in NetSuite.

darpan.audit.AuditCheck.label: Exchange credit memos whose replacement order is under another customer
darpan.audit.AuditCheck.matchedBy: credit memo id (custbody_hc_exchange_credit_memo_id on the replacement order)
darpan.audit.AuditCheck.headlineTemplate: Credit memo id {creditMemo} and its replacement order are under different customers
darpan.audit.AuditCheck.fixActionTemplate: Move the credit memo with internal id {creditMemo} to its replacement order's customer (the store's own customer when the shopper gave none).
darpan.audit.AuditCheck.passesWhenTemplate: The credit memo with internal id {creditMemo} and its replacement order have the same customer.

darpan.audit.AuditCheck.label: Exchange credit memos whose replacement is an existing order (its own original, or a year older)
darpan.audit.AuditCheck.matchedBy: credit memo id (custbody_hc_exchange_credit_memo_id on the replacement order)
darpan.audit.AuditCheck.headlineTemplate: Credit memo id {creditMemo} names an existing order as its replacement
darpan.audit.AuditCheck.fixActionTemplate: Unlink the credit memo with internal id {creditMemo} from the original order and apply it to the return's own replacement order.
darpan.audit.AuditCheck.passesWhenTemplate: The replacement of the credit memo with internal id {creditMemo} is a new order, not the one the return came from.
